title: デビュー戦の後に・次は私がっ！

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I couldn't take center stage today.
choice_data_list: It was still a great concert.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Winning concerts really are amazing, though. I was so excited.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Just being able to sing and dance in front of everyone is super fun!
choice_data_list: I bet center stage will be even more fun.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! Next time, I'll make sure I'm in the center!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: After all, I'm aiming to be a top Umadol! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her determination renewed, Smart Falcon seems full of enthusiasm as we discuss our path moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I've got a question for you! What's the first thing a freshly-debuted Umadol has to do?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Nope! Well, actually, you're not entirely wrong!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But Umadols are all about practical experience! I've gotta get more fans by putting on real concerts! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I wanna run tons of races, and this time, I'll take center stage!
choice_data_list: Then first, we'll have to win a maiden race.
Then first, we'll have to win a maiden race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! I'm still limited in the races I can compete in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Runners who don't win their debut can only compete in maiden races. Once we're over that hurdle, we can move on to more ambitious goals…
choice_data_list: Let's aim for first in the higher-level races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she places first in those races, she'll naturally attract more attention.
choice_data_list: If we can win at least two races, I think people will really start noticing you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay! ☆ I just gotta win, then!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's make everybody remember the up-and-coming Umadol, Falco! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We set our sights on winning at least two races at the Pre-Open level or higher during junior year to jump-start Smart Falcon's fame.
